sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/memphis.json: worked. About 45 Maps results, mostly remodelers, plumbers, HVAC and stores. Relevant seeds: Division 10 Inc and CGI Installation. Bobrick Washroom Equipment (Jackson TN) is a manufacturer plant and was skipped. Universal Manufacturing is the weak CBX lead. Precision Installation Services is an office-furniture installer, not partitions, and was skipped.
Bobrick find-a-rep (bobrick.com/find-a-rep): page loaded, but the locator is a dropdown and results were empty in the fetch, so no Memphis rep was obtained
ASI Global Partitions find-a-rep: HTTP 520 error
Bradley, Hadrian, Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco locators: not reached (time/budget)
The Blue Book (thebluebook.com search and iProView profiles): blocked, 403
BuildingConnected / Procore public profiles: not tried (search cap)

WebSearch (8 of 8 used): 'toilet partition installation Memphis TN', Division 10 + Memphis/Cordova/Southaven/Olive Branch, specialties/lockers Memphis, '"toilet partitions" "Memphis, TN"', Barranger Company Memphis, Division 10 Olive Branch/Southaven/Collierville/Bartlett, 'Precision Installation' Memphis, Mid-South furnish and install. Results were dominated by One Point Partitions (an online seller; its Memphis page lists a delivery terminal and a search snippet says it does not install; its site returned 403), national distributors and out-of-area firms. Out-of-area firms skipped: Allegheny Construction Specialties (Nashville), Division 10 Specialties South (GA), Restroom Stalls and All (GA), Partition Plus (MD), Holman (FL) and Martin Bros (CA).
Yelp/BBB: no Memphis-area partition installer pages surfaced in search results

candidates.name: Division 10, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Services page lists installation crews for toilet partitions, toilet accessories, operable partitions and lockers; toilet partitions are also a product line.
red_flags: Sells and supplies toilet partitions itself (dealer since 1989 for Bobrick, ASI/Accurate, Scranton, Bradley, Metpar and others): high buy-around risk
Brand list read from manufacturer logos on the manufacturers page, not page text
candidates.reason: A Memphis-area Division 10 specialty supplier with its own install crews for toilet partitions, serving contractors on commercial projects. It installs partitions, but it is also a direct partition dealer and so competes with Next Partitions.

license.name: Division 10, Inc.
license.registry: Tennessee Board for Licensing Contractors license search (verify.tn.gov, now search.cloud.commerce.tn.gov); Memphis and Shelby County Office of Construction Code Enforcement contractor registration (Accela, aca-prod.accela.com/SHELBYCO)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. The state search (verify.tn.gov redirects to search.cloud.commerce.tn.gov) is a JavaScript app (Tyler Technologies) with a reCAPTCHA check, so automated lookup was not possible and no official record was read. I found no public read-only Memphis/Shelby County registered-contractor list. The Accela portal needs a form search, which I didn't run. The company site (http://www.division10inc.com/) shows a Cordova, TN base, company phones (901) 755-2623 and (901) 753-8469, and the services 'Product sales, estimating services, installation quotes'. It doesn't name toilet partitions and shows no license number. A web search found no license record. Next step: search the TN license lookup by hand and confirm Memphis/Shelby registration with the Code Enforcement licensing section.

candidates.name: CGI Installation (CG Installations)
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage installation services list bathroom partitions and bathroom accessories, alongside shelving, lockers, doors and mezzanines, done by factory-trained installation technicians.
red_flags: No project photos or named partition projects seen
No email shown on the site (contact form only)
Large service area across 8 states; how much work it does in Memphis is unclear
candidates.reason: An install-only company based in Memphis that lists bathroom partition and accessory installation with commercial-type fixtures (lockers, shelving, racking). No sign that it sells partitions, so buy-around risk is lower. Confirm with project photos or references.

candidates.name: CBX Solutions Memphis (formerly Universal Manufacturing Co / Cook & Boardman, branch 655)
candidates.partition_evidence: The branch page says it stocks and supplies toilet partitions and restroom accessories to commercial contractors, and lists Division 10 Specialties and Installation Services among the branch's specialties. Toilet partition installation is not stated explicitly.
red_flags: Large national commercial distributor that stocks and sells toilet partitions: high buy-around risk
Mainly a door, frame and hardware distributor; partition installation not confirmed
Old URL about.cookandboardman.com/branch-locations/universal-manufacturing-co now redirects to the CBX branch page
candidates.reason: A commercial Division 8/10 distributor in Memphis that stocks toilet partitions and offers installation services, but the site never says it installs partitions. It also sells partitions directly, so it is a buy-around risk.
